agent_evaluations.detailed_comments: CRITICAL FAILURE - This content represents OSCE metadata and structure templates ONLY, with NO actual radiological interpretation content present. All 52 OSCEs contain placeholder image descriptions ('CXR for assessment', 'ECG for assessment') without ANY systematic interpretation, radiological findings, differential diagnoses, or clinical correlation. FROM RADIOLOGY EXPERT PERSPECTIVE: This is equivalent to showing an empty X-ray viewing box with no film mounted. ZERO educational value for radiology teaching. BLOCKING ISSUES: (1) No systematic approach framework (ABCDE for CXR absent from pulmonary oedema, post-op SOB, lung cancer OSCEs; 7-step ECG approach absent from bradycardia, Long QT, Silent MI, syncope OSCEs; ABC CT approach absent from stroke, headache, lung cancer OSCEs), (2) No actual radiological findings described (e.g., CARD-OSCE-0018 'Pulmonary Edema Management' CXR should specify: cardiomegaly CTR 60%, bilateral perihilar bat's wing opacification, Kerley B lines, bilateral pleural effusions - NONE of this present), (3) No RANZCR reporting structure, (4) No critical results protocols (STEMI, stroke, bowel obstruction all missing urgent management triggers), (5) No image quality teaching (rotation, inspiration, penetration for CXR; calibration for ECG). RECOMMENDATION: Complete rebuild required. Each imaging OSCE needs: (a) Actual clinical image with visible findings, (b) Systematic interpretation using appropriate framework (ABCDE/7-step/ABC), (c) Technical quality assessment, (d) Differential diagnoses, (e) Management implications, (f) Critical results communication if applicable, (g) AMC OSCE rubric with pass criteria. Current content cannot be used for AMC Clinical Examination preparation without extensive radiological content development. RAG references present but unused - citations exist but no actual medical content generated from them. PRIORITY: Delegate to content generation team to populate ALL 52 OSCEs with actual radiological interpretations before clinical deployment.
